verdict.rationale: Unity's scripting relies on C#, but the evidence pack contains no mention of an official language server (LSP) or typed API definitions specifically packaged for coding-agent tooling — only generic API/scripting manual pages and an MCP server for the editor, which is a distinct integration (editor automation, not code completion/diagnostics/navigation). Missing for 10: any documented LSP, typed .d.ts/stub-style API definitions, or IDE-attach tooling for agents; independent confirmation that agents can get completions/diagnostics via Unity-provided tooling.
